items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Produced some records with Linda Ronstadt.

ctx.x: But sometimes Milt would be on some of the concerts. We did the Hollywood Bowl, which we have some recordings of; St. Louis, Detroit. So it was nice to… one of those actually when Ron couldn’t make it Ray Brown subbed for Ron, which was fantastic for me! I got a chance to play with this master, I mean Ray… ’til his dying day was just so youthful; so full of energy, such a creative guy. He was a producer too,
you know. Produced some records with Linda Ronstadt. He was wide open. He wasn’t locked into any particular way, so I was really happy I got a chance to play with Ray.
Well, let’s talk about… obviously your work as a sideman is highly valued but let’s talk about you as a leader and can you talk about how you got the idea for forming Compost?
